evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Rep says 'Let me just gather details about the move that makes that might just take within ten to fifteen minutes. Will that be okay?' — time-boxed and framed, but no explicit 'dependable quote' promise and no clear wait for a yes before moving forward.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Never asked. Rep moves straight into logistics probing (apartment details, items, boxes) without asking 'Other than price, what are your biggest concerns about this move?'
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: N/A — no concerns were raised by the customer.
evidence_quotes.active_listening_reflection: N/A — no concerns were raised by the customer.
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Property type (2-bed apartment, then 2-bed townhome), floor/stories (second floor apartment, 3-story townhome), walking distance (150 yards from garage), items (wicker chairs, mirror, adjustable bed frame, queen bed frame, 65-inch TV, 40 boxes, modular couch), parking (designated truck spot, public elevator). All seven categories covered.
evidence_quotes.packing_services_offered: Rep asked 'would you need help packing, sir?' and customer said everything was already packed. However, this was reactive — the rep did not proactively offer packing as a service in the standard way.
evidence_quotes.box_count_asked: 'For a two bedroom apartment backs count is within 25 to 35 how many total number of boxes do you think are we going to move for you?' Customer answered 40 boxes.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Rep says 'I'm estimating them move to take around five and a half to six and a half hour, sir. So it's good to budget an overall of $101,221 to $1,443' — typographical/verbal error in price range, but a range is anchored to the home size. Later adds 30 minutes to the estimate based on system data showing prior long-walk moves at that building. Personalized to the specific logistics challenge.
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Rep mentions 'whatever time is consumed or accumulated that's only what you pay for' (hourly pay-only framing) and later adds 'There's gonna be no extra fee' (fee transparency). Does not explicitly mention trip fee, overnight fee, packing materials, 2.5-hour minimum, or 15-minute increments.
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: Never asked. Rep does not ask 'Does that feel fair?' or any equivalent. Call ends with 'I'll send you your email, okay? Alright, sir. Bye-bye.'
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee_delivered: Never mentioned. No discussion of discount terms or on-time assurance.
evidence_quotes.damage_coverage_delivered: Never mentioned. No discussion of $2,000 coverage, no-deductible framing, or built-in protection.
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: No Two Promises section delivered at all, so no loop-closing question asked.
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Not asked. Rep ends call abruptly after sending the estimate email, with no 'What's still concerning you?' or similar genuine check.
evidence_quotes.catch_all_asked: Not asked. No 'Anything coming with you we haven't talked about?' — the closest is the customer volunteering late in the call 'Oh, I was just gonna ask. So, I may have already typed it in and that's why you didn't answer but we do have one couch as well,' showing the customer had to self-identify a missing item.
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Never asked. Rep never says 'Would you like our help with your move?' or any recognizable variant. Call ends with administrative wrap-up: 'I'll send you your email, okay?'
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: None of the required elements confirmed. No date confirmation (the online intake shows October 3rd, but the rep does not re-confirm it on this call), no phone number collected, no arrival window set, no crew size discussed, no addresses re-confirmed, no notes left for the crew about the customer's concerns (long walk, special items).

top_strength: Arden systematically gathered comprehensive logistics details — property type, floor, walking distance, all special items, and box count — and proactively adjusted the estimate upward when system data surfaced a risk (long hallway walk), showing attentiveness to move-day accuracy.
coaching_note: This call skipped the entire discovery and commitment arc: never asked about concerns, never delivered the Two Promises, never asked 'Does that feel fair?', and critically never asked for the business or confirmed booking details — it ended as an administrative info-dump rather than a sales conversation.
